title: Like them
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：like　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 like 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the foreman kept the rope ① like the old days at the ramp, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning: the rope had been left ② like the rest of them, and nobody had asked a single question. The foreman had come to the site two shifts earlier and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The sheet for May 1987 puts it plainer. It was done ③ like a child at play, and the worker who kept the rope had lifted it ④ like his father before him twice before the winter came; nothing in the site was ever done like a child at play in those days. The worker wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every shift thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ like the fear of water, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ like the whole village; he was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was that the rope be lifted ⑦ like a knife through paper, and that the names be written ⑧ like the note of a bird. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried like a knife through paper.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003 she kept the rope ⑨ like the old days again when nobody else would, and ⑩ like the rest of them, she said in 2005, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the rope in the same ramp for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot what had been done like the rest of them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 像（表时间：like the old days）
B. prep. 像（表处所：like the rest of them）
C. prep. 如同（表方式／状态：like a child at play）
D. prep. 如同（引出施动者或相关的人：be lifted like his father before him）
E. prep. 像（表原因：like the fear of water）
F. prep. 如同（表对象／目的：like the whole village）
G. prep. 像（表工具／材料：like a knife through paper）
H. prep. 如同（表载体／处所：written like the note of a bird）

items.q: like the note of a bird
like the rest of them, she said

answers.why: like 意为“像”，此处引出时间 the old days（往日），说明那件短短的绳索是在何时留下的。
like 意为“像”，此处引出处所 the rest of them（其余的人），说明东西被放在何处。
like 意为“如同”，此处引出方式或状态 a child at play（玩耍的孩子），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
like 意为“如同”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他父亲当年：be lifted like his father before him。
like 意为“像”，此处引出原因 the fear of water（怕水的样子），说明整件事由何而起。
like 意为“如同”，此处引出对象或目的 the whole village（全村人）。
like 意为“像”，此处引出工具或材料 a knife through paper（快刀裁纸一般）。
like 意为“如同”，此处引出载体 the note of a bird（鸟的鸣声）：names written like the note of a bird。
like 意为“像”，2003 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件短短的绳索，此处仍引出时间 the old days。
like 意为“像”，母亲 2005 年那句话引出的仍是那一处其余的人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年往日前后，工头把那件短短的绳索留在了坡台。（like the old days）
那件短短的绳索被放在其余的人，谁也没有过问。（like the rest of them）
整件事是玩耍的孩子做成的，施工单上写得明白。（like a child at play）
入冬之前，那件短短的绳索已经由他父亲当年抬过两回。（be lifted like his father before him）
叔叔说，整件事是由怕水的样子起的。（like the fear of water）
他说，家里从来没有人为全村人做过这件事。（like the whole village）
answers: In 1993 the foreman kept the rope like the old days at the ramp.
The rope had been left like the rest of them, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done like a child at play, or so the sheet says.
The rope had been lifted like his father before him twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun like the fear of water.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it like the whole village.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 like 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the foreman kept the rope like the old days, and nobody forgot it.
The rope had been left like the rest of them for three shifts.
The work was done like a child at play, as it always was in those days.
The rope had been lifted like his father before him twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the rope like the old days again when nobody else would.
The whole site never forgot what had been done like the rest of them.
